# Third-party notices

Convertible itself is released under the MIT licence (see `LICENSE`). It is written in-house;
the few components below were written elsewhere and are distributed with it under their own
permissive licences. Every app shows these notices on its licences screen.

## Imported source code (compiled into the core)

Kept in-tree under `core/src/imported/`, compiled from source with the core, never downloaded
at build time. Each directory carries a `VENDOR.json` and the upstream licence files.

## Android app libraries

The Android app is the only part of Convertible that links libraries written elsewhere: the
platform's own Jetpack libraries and Kotlin coroutines. Gradle resolves them at build time;
their transitive dependencies (including the Kotlin standard library) are under the same
licence. Test-only and debug-only libraries are not shipped and are not listed.
